summary: Post-index-optimization regression pass. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases passed against preview (login, /api/health, /api/reports/dashboard, /api/leads/followups/analytics, /api/leads?page=1&limit=25 + page=2 + sorted, /api/leads/{id}, /api/leads/{id}/followups, /api/leads/{id}/caller-activities, /api/chatter/messages?lead_id&page=1&limit=25, POST /api/reports/pivot rows=user_id and rows=source_lead+cols=lead_stage, /api/reports/trends). All endpoints responded 200 well under the 10-15s ceilings. Frontend: logged in as admin@homeivf.com; Dashboard renders all widgets (KPIs 50/4,069/246/33/73,703/1,10,956, Incoming Leads 14d bar chart, Funnel by stage, Caller Leaderboard MTD, Top Dispositions MTD, no errors). Leads page shows paginated list — footer reads '1,10,956 leads · page 1 of 2,220', 50 rows/page, Next button present. Opening lead #132659 loads its detail with Chatter (4 msgs), Activities, WhatsApp, Calls, Attachments tabs, Contact + Case Details, no errors. Reports page renders the Pivot Builder with Caller × Disposition Tag table populated across all 24 callers. No 500s, no console errors on the flows tested. Index additions are functioning as intended.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py startup() creates ~40 indexes serially on each boot — idempotent but adds startup latency; consider a one-shot migration or asyncio.gather for parallel create_index calls.
/api/reports/pivot is POST-only; if a GET variant is ever expected by clients, mention it in docs. Non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 46 verified the MongoDB index optimization change in server.py (follow_ups, caller_activities, wa_tracking, leads compound). Reusable regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_perf_sections.py — 13 tests, ~2s total. Pivot endpoint is POST /api/reports/pivot with body {rows:[...], cols:'...', filters:{}}. Lead IDs are integer-strings like '132659'. Chatter endpoint that works: /api/chatter/messages?lead_id={id}&page=1&limit=25.
rca of the issue: N/A — this was a performance optimization verification, no bug.
